attributes.action: Require all restaurants to provide non-religiously slaughtered meat options
attributes.additional_details:
Some restaurants exclusively serve meat that has undergone religious slaughter, leaving consumers who prefer non-religiously slaughtered meat without an alternative. We believe no consumer should be limited to meat prepared or certified according to religious requirements they do not share, and that freedom of choice and conscience should be respected.
 
This petition does not seek to ban religiously slaughtered meat or restrict religious freedom. It seeks to ensure that non-religious alternatives are available, protecting consumer choice regardless of personal or religious beliefs.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to require all non-vegetarian restaurants to offer meat options that have not been religiously slaughtered, to protect consumers’ freedom of choice and ensure everyone can choose meat that aligns with their personal beliefs, religious convictions and dietary preferences.
